name: Harmony 650, the Denon kept on between activities
description: Opportunistic, beside todo-compile-650 3.10: no write. The remote holds Logitech's compile of the starting setup with MyHarmony's 'keep this device on when switching Activities' set on the Denon (h650_options_config, section 340). In that compile Muziek's start no longer writes the Denon's power 0, while All Off still does. Predicted: TV kijken switches the Denon on; switching to Muziek switches the LG and the KPN box off and Kodi and the Sony on, and sends the Denon nothing; All Off then switches the Denon off together with Kodi and the Sony. Keep the remote off the cable and pointed at the Flirc.

steps.instruction: Press All Off, so every device starts off. The Flirc may hear power off codes for whatever the remote still counted as on, or nothing. Mark when it is quiet

Press the Watch TV key. Expect 'Starting TV kijken', the power on codes of the LG, the KPN box and the Denon, then the LG's HDMI 1 and the Denon's CBL/SAT input, and then TV kijken's screen. Mark when it settles

Press the Listen to Music key. Expect 'Starting Muziek', Kodi's and the Sony's power codes, the LG's and the KPN box's power codes switching them off, and the Sony's Audio 2 input. Expect NO power code for the Denon: it stays on. Mark when it settles, and mark anything sent to the Denon
Press All Off. Expect Kodi, the Sony and the Denon switching off: the Denon's PowerOff is the proof the remote still counted it as on
